title: rabdosia glaucocalyx
intro: Rabdosia glaucocalyx, commonly known as Himalayan Gold or Gauwak, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rabdosia glaucocalyx include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit analgesic and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its diverse pharmacological effects.
